summary: Interactive field object (chest, door, search spot, signboard, save point): a 2D sprite actor with a position/direction/frame table plus a chain of embedded sub-objects (action trigger, handle slots, handler lists, row list) that drive its state machine and UI reaction.
evidence: Field_Gimmick_Ctor (0x005E4A78) stores the vtable at +0, the id at +4 and chains 26 sub-object constructors at fixed offsets, returning base+0x1FDC-0x1FDC; Field_Gimmick_InitFromRecord (0x002BE0E4) fills the sprite/position/frame-table block 0x230..0x34A from a 0x2C-byte map record; Field_Gimmick_Update (0x002BDB4C) reads 0x248/0x24C/0x78/0x7C/0x80/0x98/0x9C/0xBC/0xB0/0xB4; Field_Gimmick_StepAnimFrame (0x002BDECC) walks the 0x18-byte frame table at 0x248 with the index at 0x2A8; Field_Gimmick_CheckAllReady (0x0016C0A4) walks the intrusive list at 0x10C/0x110 and the 0x2C8-byte records at 0xE8; Field_Gimmick_StepSelection (0x005E35CC) uses the selection range 0x1550..0x155C. The same object is class Field_UiGimmick in S_037 (vtable 0x00784174, size 0x1FE0, entryList/rowList/slotList at 0x1570/0x1D7C/0x1FDC); this batch merges that object with its 47 embedded sub-object vtables, so the names for those three offsets are taken from S_037. The Ui_Object / Fs_ResourceSet / Battle_Effect constructors in bases_seen are the embedded sub-objects, not a real base class: the gimmick has its own vtable at +0 and its own fields from +4 on.
